name: Teenage Dirtbag
storyline: The story centers around a group of California high school students through the perspective of Miles, an antisocial and mentally ill boy whose only bright spot in life is his crush, Michael.
summary:
Teenage Dirtbag is a game based around introducing our ocs. There is no inherent goal in the game and your choices don't really matter. It's a simple introduction to our main cast.

With a relatively shallow plot and one ending, this game was something we thought about for a few years and now we finally made it (it's a bit rough and not entirely done/polished, but it is still playable).
